validation_notes: The right side of the chart shows a choppy, range-bound consolidation between roughly 0.00465 and 0.00475, but there's no clear convergence between an ascending support line and a flat/descending resistance line. Lows since Aug 3 are relatively flat (around 0.0046-0.00465) rather than rising, and highs are also flat-to-declining, more resembling a horizontal range/rectangle than a converging triangle. I don't see a credible rising trendline connecting at least two-three higher lows that would meet a flat resistance near an apex. The algorithm's 'ascending triangle' flag seems to be picking up on minor higher-low noise rather than a genuine structural pattern. Overall this looks like sideways consolidation after a downtrend, not a well-defined triangle.
